text:
sam: Hey folks — trying to lock down time for the CNI outage postmortem. I think we should budget 60m (45m discussion + 15m action triage). Prefer Wed/Thu mornings. Who needs to be in?
tara: I'm good Wed 10am PT. Thu morning also works.
david: Thu preferred for me (timezone).
leila: Either is fine. +1 for 45/15 split.
maya: Same — would like network team there for RCA context.
sam: Proposed agenda (owners inline) — please flag missing items:
```
1) Timeline walk (sam) — 15m
2) Root cause analysis (david) — 15m
3) Impact & comms (tara) — 10m
4) What we'd do differently (all) — 5m
5) Action triage & owners (all) — 15m
```
calendar-bot: Poll created — Option A: Wed 10:00am PT, Option B: Thu 9:30am PT. Vote by EOD.
tara: Can we include a quick pre-read (1 pager) so attendees can skip the timeline if already reviewed?
sam: yes — I'll drop a short timeline + logs link in #docs by EOD today.
david: I'll attach the request traces and a short note on mitigation attempts.
leila: I can facilitate unless someone else prefers.
maya: happy to co-facilitate and take notes.
sam: thanks — assigning facilitation to leila/maya. Also adding jordan (PM) for comms.
tara: PM presence is important for customer follow-ups — @jordan please confirm.
jordan: I'm available Thu 9:30am PT, will join and prep the customer impact summary.
sam: small ask on format: attach any logs or short bullet points to the pre-read doc (link will be in thread). Timebox strictly to keep to 60m.
leila: noted — I'll keep us on-track and call timeboxes.
maya: I'll maintain the action tracker during the meeting — will assign owners live.
calendar-bot: Event created: Thu 9:30am PT — invites sent to sam, tara, david, leila, maya, jordan, network-team.
sam: please add any other owners or evidence to the pre-read by tomorrow noon. If you can't make Thu, say so here and we'll pick alternate.
tara: ack, will add comms bullets.
david: ack, adding logs.
maya: ack.
sam: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
